getting gui · 开始做 GUI

既然人生苦短，何必把圆涂成纯色——明明有个渐变等着你

Because life's too short to paint the circle a solid color when there's a gradient blend waiting for you · 《Head First Java》p475
public void paintComponent(Graphics g) {

    Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D) g;   // 强制转换它，好让我们能调用 Graphics2D 有、而 Graphics 没有的东西

    GradientPaint gradient = new GradientPaint(70, 70, Color.blue, 150, 150, Color.orange);

    g2d.setPaint(gradient);   // 把虚拟画笔从纯色设置为渐变
    g2d.fillOval(70, 70, 100, 100);
}

↑ 它其实是一个伪装成普通 Graphics 对象的 Graphics2D 对象。↑ 起点、起始颜色、终点、终止颜色。↑ fillOval() 方法实际上的意思是"用你画笔上装着的东西（也就是这个渐变）来填满这个椭圆"。

public void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
    Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D) g;

    Random random = new Random();
    int red = random.nextInt(256);
    int green = random.nextInt(256);
    int blue = random.nextInt(256);
    Color startColor = new Color(red, green, blue);

    red = random.nextInt(256);
    green = random.nextInt(256);
    blue = random.nextInt(256);
    Color endColor = new Color(red, green, blue);

    GradientPaint gradient = new GradientPaint(70, 70, startColor, 150, 150, endColor);
    g2d.setPaint(gradient);
    g2d.fillOval(70, 70, 100, 100);
}

↑ 这跟上面那个一样，只不过它给渐变的起点色和终点色生成了随机的颜色。试试看！
